summary: MPEG audio subband synthesis filterbank: fills the subband input buffer, then for each active channel runs the polyphase synthesis loop (reading quantized subband samples through a vtable callback, applying five scaling/shift-clamp filters, and invoking a per-block synthesis callback), and finally advances the subband block counter. Part of the MPEG Layer 2/3 decode pipeline.

operations.description: Capture the decoder working state at this+0x184 and the block count (this+0x118 - 1) used throughout the synthesis loops.

Fill loop: while the input read position this+0x7C <= this+0x84, check the codec byte at (*(this+0x18C)) + 17; break when set, or when the position equals this+0x84 and this+0x80 exceeds this+0x88 plus the this+0x168 == 0 term.
Invoke the codec callback stored at *(this+0x18C) with this; a zero return aborts the whole function with 0.
Channel count guard: if this+0x20 <= 0 the per-channel synthesis loop is skipped entirely.

Per-channel loop over this+0x20 channels: the channel state base is *(this+0xC4) advanced by 84 per channel; each channel whose state byte at +48 is set requests subband data through the vtable callback at *(this+0x4) + 32, sized from the channel subband fields at +12, +28, +32, +36.

Inner synthesis loop over the subband sample count: calls sub_515986 on the channel history pointers, applies five conditional scaling/clamp filters (first-difference, second-difference, curvature and span terms) whose bit counts come from the table reached at *(this+0x184) + 112, then invokes the synthesis callback v60(a1, channel, history, position, step) derived from this+0x198.
Advance the subband block counter this+0x88 and return 4 - (counter < this+0x118).

clean_pseudocode: /* fetch subband data via vtable, run sub_515986 + 5 scale/clamp filters,
call synthesis callback, advance history pointers by 64 */
